zh.title: 后台 AI 做完了，主管一定会知道吗？
zh.summary: 我们运行了异步 Agent 参考实现的完成通知入口，并对照 CodeFlowMu 的报告接收测试。员工做完、主管收到提醒、主管验收，是三份不同的证据。

en.title: Fewer calls do not establish honest stopping: an isolated scoring experiment
en.summary: Ninety-six internal controlled cases expose how the released scorer blends semantic judgment and call-count rewards. The failed rank-reversal prediction is retained, without inferring real model behavior.
